## Erchitu (Human Form) (CR 3)

This horrific beast resembles a great white minotaur with pitch black eyes and iron-coated horns. Its bellow is like an announcement of doom.  

**XP** 800  
Human afflicted erchitu brawler 3  
NE Medium humanoid (human, shapechanger)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +7  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+4 armor, +1 Dex)  
**hp** 39 (3d10+9)  
**Fort** +5, **Ref** +4, **Will** +2; +4 on Fort vs. nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments, and suffocation damage (Endurance)  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** mwk handaxe +7 (1d6+2/x3) or unarmed strike +5 (1d6+2) or unarmed strike brawler’s flurry +3/+3 (1d6+2)  
**Special Attacks** brawler’s flurry (Two-Weapon Fighting), martial flexilbility 4/day, maneuver training (bull rush +1)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 14, **Dex** 13, **Con** 14, **Int** 10, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +5 (+8 with bull rush); **CMD** 16 (19 vs. bull rush)  
**Feats** Crushing Impact, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Unarmed Strike, Improved Bull Rush, [Weapon Focus (handaxe)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (handaxe).*  
**Skills** Intimidate +6, Knowledge (local) +6, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** brawler’s cunning, change shape (human, hybrid, and auroch; polymorph), martial training  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any land  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** NPC gear (chain shirt, mwk handaxe, other gear)

## Erchitu (Hybrid Form) (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
Human afflicted erchitu brawler 3  
NE Large humanoid (human, shapechanger)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +7  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 42 (3d10+12)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +4, **Will** +2; +4 on Fort vs. nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments, and suffocation damage (Endurance)  
**DR** 5/silver  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** mwk handaxe +7 (1d8+3/x3) or unarmed strike +5 (1d8+3), gore +5 (1d8+3), or unarmed strike brawler’s flurry +3/+3 (1d8+3)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** brawler’s flurry (Two-Weapon Fighting), death bellow, iron horns, martial flexilbility 4/day, maneuver training (bull rush +1), stampede, trample (2d6+4, DC 14)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 13, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +7 (+10 with bull rush); **CMD** 18 (21 vs. bull rush)  
**Feats** Crushing Impact, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Unarmed Strike, Improved Bull Rush, [Weapon Focus (handaxe)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (handaxe).*  
**Skills** Intimidate +6, Knowledge (local) +6, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** brawler’s cunning, change shape (human, hybrid, and auroch; polymorph), lycanthropic empathy (wild and domesticated bovines), martial training  


**Special Abilities**



**Brawler’s Cunning (Ex)** As the sample erchitu is a 3rd-level brawler, its Intelligence counts as 13 for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of combat feats.  

**Brawler’s Flurry (Ex)** As the sample erchitu is a 3rd-level brawler, it can make a brawler’s flurry as a full-attack action. When doing so, it has the Two-Weapon Fighting feat when attacking with any combination of unarmed strikes, weapons from the close fighter weapon group, or weapons with the “monk” special feature. It does not need to use two different weapons to use this ability. The erchitu applies its full Strength modifier to its damage rolls for all attacks made with brawler’s flurry, whether the attacks are made with an off-hand weapon or a weapon wielded in both hands.
